data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001's transfer claim asserts that 'checklist compliance tracking the right answer without causal anchoring will produce a characteristic failure mode under feature perturbation.' But the problem asks for evidence 'within a single evaluation' — feature perturbation is a separate intervention requiring multiple evaluations. No internal evidence within one evaluation is offered to distinguish genuine gain from compliance. The claim's strongest distinguishing criterion is therefore out-of-scope.
